mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions and reduced industrial output lower corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakening in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), higher interest rates increase borrowing costs and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.
